dedupe_keys.name: ai hub water supply pipe leak detection data korea

description: This AI-Hub dataset holds leak detection data from sensors installed on water supply pipeline meter boxes and valves in Korea, labelled by leak survey experts who found the leaks in the field, to train artificial intelligence to tell leaks from other sounds. It provides 50,000 records as CSV in five classes: 10,000 outdoor leaks, 10,000 indoor leaks, 5,000 mechanical or electrical noise, 5,000 environmental noise and 20,000 normal sounds. Built in 2020 and released in June 2021, it reports an accuracy of 90 percent with an XGBoost classifier against a 90 percent reference and has been downloaded about 1,370 times. Coverage: Korean pipelines, a labelled sample, not a full network. Access: free, but the page states only Korean nationals can apply for the data; the licence is not stated. Caveats: sample data were removed in 2022 because labels were missing, and the sensor sites and dates were not stated. It supports leak detection and network loss reduction models, and relates to the Korean national water supply information system record in the catalogue.
